work_package: B6-FFAP-SEEDS (wave 2) for steps 0 to 3.2 and B7-FFAP-FEATURES (wave 3) for steps 3.3 and 4; algorithm.rs, this manifest and the support document passed from B6 to B7; port/ffap-semantics (wave 4) for the degenerate bins, FeatureFinderDefs, UnableToFit, the Linux x86_64 Release re-baseline and the intended abundance override evidence; port/ffap-complete (wave 5): the merge with port/ffap-instrumentation and the combined fix round of the lead decisions D1-D9 (every source sort in the Release order, the Release build's powf, the area iterator's drift-time filter, the step-2.5 length_error, ChargedIndexSet equality, glibc -nan)
scope: FEATUREFINDER/FeatureFinderAlgorithmPicked.h/.cpp end to end, merged (port/ffap-complete): getDefaultParameters, updateMembers_ and the run_ parameter reads, the input checks of run with MSExperiment::isSorted, sortSpectra and sortChromatograms (libstdc++ introsort of the spectra and chromatograms, libstdc++ 14.4.0 std::stable_sort of each unsorted spectrum's and chromatogram's peaks), steps 0 to 3.2 (intensity quantiles with the area iterator's drift-time filter and the introsort of each cell, scores, trace scores and local maxima, isotope-pattern precalculation with the Release Size conversion and std::length_error above vector::max_size(), pattern scores, overall scores with the reference build's glibc 2.39 powf, user seeds sorted in place and seed selection), positionScore_, nearest_, findIsotope_, isotopeScore_, both intensityScore_ overloads (the undefined UInt conversion of a zero or infinite bin step reproduced as the Linux x86_64 Release build computes it, DegenerateBinStep::Refuse as the opt-out) and getIsotopeDistribution_; steps 3.3 and 4 (findBestIsotopeFit_, extendMassTraces_, extendMassTrace_, chooseTraceFitter_, cropFeature_, checkFeatureQuality_, intersection_, the abort bookkeeping and the overlap resolution); FeatureFinderDefs (with std::set's comparisons for ChargedIndexSet); the instance, write_debug and progress (tests/data/feature_finder_picked_instrumentation_provenance.json). Undefined behaviour follows the Linux x86_64 Release build wherever its outcome is measured, repeatable, explained by the executed instructions and in bounds (lead decision D1); refused only at the endless NaN-RT profile merge (CPP-242) and the terminating step-3.3.5 exception; the introsort's out-of-bounds guard is kept but unreachable for the algorithm's asymmetric comparisons. 64-bit integer parameters are narrowed and converted as the Release build does (tests/data/feature_finder_picked_instrumentation_provenance.json, combined fix round 2).
method: Port with executed differential tests. The C2 class-level driver ffap_stages and the B6 driver seed_stage (as its generalisation degenerate_stage) run FeatureFinderAlgorithmPicked::run and read its protected state through a derived probe class; since port/ffap-semantics the fixtures come from the Linux x86_64 Release build openms4-release-bc9cc12-c19e494-174b576 (ibminode06), extracted by the unchanged B6 and B7 scripts through ../oracle/ffap-sem-completion/extract. tests/feature_finder_picked_seeds.rs rebuilds every configuration with the Rust loaders and compares members, quantiles, isotope windows, all per-peak score arrays and the ordered seed lists bit for bit, plus the degenerate-bin captures (every array with its NaN bits and intensityScore_ as a double), the intensityScore_ probe and the FeatureFinderDefs probe. tests/feature_finder_picked.rs runs the algorithm on each feature-stage configuration, replays step 3.3 seed by seed through the public extension and fitting functions, and compares the intended abundance override with an adapted Release replay (intended_abundance.cpp). tests/topp_feature_finder_centroided.rs compares the tool with the executed Release tool on the degenerate and short inputs and the changed abundance. The executed FeatureFinderCentroided -write_ini output (C1, product SDK) pins the defaults. The disassembly of intensityScore_ in libOpenMS.so explains the degenerate-bin outcome. The combined fix round (port/ffap-complete) adds ../oracle/ffap-complete-fix1: the stage driver nonfinite_stage_dt (52 cases: sort keys, drift times, window counts around vector::max_size(); sort_mobility_stage.tsv.gz, replayed by sort_and_mobility_cases_match_the_linux_release_build), sort_probe (libOpenMS.so's sortByPosition, sortSpectra, sortChromatograms and FeatureMap::sortByMZ on 2,272 inputs, with a replaced operator new(nothrow) for the partial and missing temporary buffer; sort_probe.tsv.gz, every_source_sort_matches_the_executed_library), powf_probe (the host powf through dlsym; glibc_powf_probe.tsv, unit tests of glibc_powf, and outside CI every binary32 base with y = 1/3 and 2^26 pairs in four sets against a release build of the same module) and defs_eq_probe (defs_eq_probe.tsv). The overall scores are now compared bit for bit everywhere; the rounding rows only assert that the executed and the port's value is the misrounded one.
evidence_tier: tier 1 (executed differential, Linux x86_64 Release build openms4-release-bc9cc12-c19e494-174b576): effective members, intensity bins and quantiles, isotope windows, every per-peak trace, intensity, local-maximum, pattern and overall score bit for bit (the overall score is the reference build's glibc 2.39 powf, reproduced; the 8 of 30,840 scores it rounds one binary32 step from the correctly rounded power included), printed seed counts and min_spectra 1 behaviour over 7 configurations; the degenerate intensity bins over 26 configurations and 228 intensityScore_ probe positions; the final features of six configurations (bit for bit on Linux x86_64 glibc except the EGH configuration, 2.3038e-12); 189 non-finite and 52 sort, drift-time and step-2.5 stage cases (every returned run and exception reproduced, the endless runs refused at the merge); every source sort (2,272 inputs, full, partial and no temporary buffer); glibc powf (special grid, generated sets, every binary32 base with the exponent 1/3); FeatureFinderDefs and ChargedIndexSet comparisons. Adapted: the ordered seed lists (source replicas) and the intended abundance override (adapted Release replay). Tier 3: the class-test sections including #9247. Tier 4: the refused undefined cases (charge wrap, CPP-242, the step-3.3.5 termination). The introsort's out-of-bounds guard is unreachable for the algorithm's comparisons (proved in the source_sort module documentation; no executed or generated input reaches it); it is reached only by comparators that are not asymmetric, through the public source_sort_permutation (unit tests).

The macOS arm64 product SDK's Apple powf misrounded 99. The feature stage is exact on Linux x86_64 glibc except the EGH configuration (2.3038e-12); macOS arm64 is within 5.355e-13 except two ill-conditioned Gaussian fits (1.07e-3) that no feature depends on. The stage captures (non-finite, and the combined fix round's sort and mobility cases) compare the same way through a digest of every quantile and score, with the full rows where few differ; their features are exact on Linux x86_64 glibc and on macOS arm64 within 5.4e-13 except 12 ill-conditioned fits (up to 1.1156e-12, 6.5974e-8 and 4.9245e-4, NONFINITE_FIT_GAP). Every sort order and buffer request of sort_probe, every powf value of powf_probe and every ChargedIndexSet comparison is exact.

run_ step 0: max_isotopes 20, +1000 per changed abundance, overrides inserted into a default IsotopeDistribution
UInt charge_count = charge_high - charge_low + 1; 3 + 2 * charge_count float arrays
step 1: byMSLevel(1) grid, inclusive areaBeginConst cells, 21 quantiles floor(0.05 * i * (n - 1)), intensity scores stored as float
step 2: following then preceding scans, positionScore_ sum / (2 * min_spectra_), strict float intensity for local maximum
step 2.5: ceil(max_mz * charge_high / width) + 1 windows, trimLeft/trimRight at intensity_percentage_optional, optional begin/end, max normalisation
step 3.1: max_element anchor, findNearest start, findIsotope_ per isotope, isotopeScore_ with m/z, max per peak
step 3.2: std::pow(float product, 1.0f / 3.0f), local maximum, seed:min_score or user-seed search, std::sort(seeds.rbegin(), seeds.rend())
std::cout Found N seeds for charge c.

updateMembers_: min_spectra_ floor(x * 0.5), percentages / 100
getIsotopeDistribution_: floor(mass / width), InvalidValue beyond the table
nearest_: linear upward walk while strictly closer
findIsotope_: centre, previous, next; non-zero position score matches; means
positionScore_

step 4: overlap resolution, the intensity-zero removal and the apex annotation
